meta.notes: Swiss file only, so no Liechtenstein addresses; planned (projektiert) addresses dropped, real ones kept whether or not ADR_OFFICIAL; id ADR_EGAID; house_number ADR_NUMBER as written (GWR decimals like 31.1 included); road STN_LABEL; ZIP_LABEL split into postcode and city (the postal locality); state is the canton code COM_CANTON; LV95 EPSG:2056 transformed to EPSG:4326 with pyproj
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS
